# Mystudionet Productions | Long Island Wedding Films

> Cinematic wedding films for couples across Long Island, Suffolk County,
> Nassau County, the Hamptons, and New Jersey. Founded by filmmaker Kursad
> Yonet: 20+ years of experience, 300+ weddings filmed. Cinematic documentary
> style, licensed music, professional color grading. Packages start at $2,400
> for 8 hours of coverage. Free consultation at https://wedding.mystudionet.com/#consultation

## Pages

- [Home](https://wedding.mystudionet.com/): wedding film portfolio, packages, FAQ and consultation booking
- [The Wedding Journal](https://wedding.mystudionet.com/blog/) (https://wedding.mystudionet.com/blog/index.md): advice articles for couples
